Package com.hkust.marketplace.testcase

Class AdminFrontendControllerTest

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.testcase.AdminFrontendControllerTest
@DisplayName("Task 3 Frontend: AdminLoginController & AdminDashboardController Tests") @Timeout(120L) public class AdminFrontendControllerTest extends Object
Automated JavaFX Frontend Controller Test Suite for AdminLoginController and AdminDashboardController.

File Placement: HKUST-Marketplace/src/test/java/com/hkust/marketplace/testcase/AdminFrontendControllerTest.java

How to Run:

  1. Run inside a normal desktop session (required by JavaFX) with MySQL 8 running and hkust_marketplace initialized from src/main/resources/db/schema.sql.
  2. Ensure DB credentials are configured via MARKETPLACE_DB_USER / MARKETPLACE_DB_PASSWORD or ~/.hkust-marketplace/database.properties.
  3. In IntelliJ IDEA: right-click this file -> More Run/Debug -> Run with Coverage.
  4. Or via Maven: .\mvnw.cmd verify -Dtest=AdminFrontendControllerTest.

How Modal Alerts and Dialogs Are Tested Without Hanging: A lightweight JavaFX Timeline watcher runs on the FX Application Thread during each test. Because JavaFX showAndWait() uses a nested event loop, the watcher continues ticking while any Alert, TextInputDialog, or custom Dialog is open, matches queued AdminFrontendControllerTest.DialogRule actions (typing inputs, clicking OK/Cancel/Save), records alert messages for assertion, and auto-dismisses any unexpected popup so tests never deadlock. Dialog actions are deferred with Platform.runLater(Runnable) so a controller alert opened from a dialog's button handler is not created during a JavaFX animation/layout pulse (which would throw "showAndWait is not allowed during animation or layout processing").

Database Safety: Every test uses a unique random prefix (e.g. fx1a2b3c4d_) for all temporary accounts, listings, deals, reviews, and notifications, and cleans up all created rows in tearDown(). Seeded demo accounts (admin, alice, bob, charlie, diana) are never altered.
